## Human Skeleton Warrior (CR 14)

**XP** 38,400  
Human skeleton warrior fighter 13  
NE Medium undead (augmented humanoid)  
 **Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9; **Aura** fear aura (30 ft., DC 18)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 27, touch 12, flat-footed 25 (+11 armor, +1 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)  
 **hp** 169 (13d10+26 plus 13)  
 **Fort** +12; **Ref** +9; **Will** +7; +3 vs. fear  
 **Defensive Abilities** bravery +3; **DR** 10/magic and bludgeoning; **Immune** channel energy, undead traits; **SR** 28  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** +2 bastard sword +25/+20/+15 (1d10+16/17–20)  
 **Ranged** mwk longbow +17/+12/+7 (1d8+2/x3)  
 **Special Attacks** weapon training (heavy blades +3, bows +2, light blades +1)  
 **Spell–like Abilities** (CL 13th):  

  Constant—find target  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 22, **Dex** 13, Con—, **Int** 8, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 14  
 **Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 31  
 **Feats** Alertness, Blind-FightB, CleaveB, Critical FocusB, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Great CleaveB, Improved Critical (bastard sword)B, Improved InitiativeB, Improved Sunder, Lightning Reflexes, Quick DrawB, Run, Weapon Focus (bastard sword), Weapon Specialization (bastard sword), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
 **Skills** Climb +13, Intimidate +26, Perception +9, Sense Motive +9, Swim +14; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Intimidate, +6 Perception, +6 Sense Motive  
 **Languages** Common  
 **SQ** armor training 3  
 **Gear** +2 full plate, +2 bastard sword, masterwork longbow, 20 arrows, cloak of resistance +2, boots of speed  

**Special Abilities**

 **Fear Aura (Su)** Skeleton warriors are shrouded in an aura of fear. Creatures with less than 5 HD and in a 30-foot radius must succeed on a Will save or be affected as though by fear cast by a caster of the skeleton warrior’s levels.  

 **Find Target (Sp)** A skeleton warrior can track and find the possessor of its circlet unerringly, as though guided by *discern location*. Using this ability, it can also find the last person to possess its circlet. Its caster level is equal to its total Hit Dice.
